verdict.rationale: The only security-relevant evidence is a generic statement that Bitbucket offers 2FA. It does not say whether hardware security keys, WebAuthn/FIDO2, or passkeys are supported as a second factor. Generic 2FA is an adjacent control, possibly TOTP-only, so it earns no credit for this specific story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use a hardware security key or passkey as a second factor

citations.quote: 2FA and IP allowlisting keep your code accessible only by authorized users.
